about: BattleSim (src/core/battle_sim.gd): setup + seed -> every event of every step() in order, outcome() and the final units. manual_ultimates: before step number `tick` (1 = first step), request_ultimate(uid); `accepted` is its result. Then run_to_end() on a fresh sim must give the same outcome.

battles.name: opening_stage_1_1
battles.about: A new player's formation (three level 1 Rares) against stage 1-1, as Game.stage_battle_setup builds it.

battles.name: boss_1_5
battles.about: Stage 1-5 boss (Cassiel echo: boss multipliers, halved stuns) against a first-session team.

battles.name: five_star_kits_a
battles.about: Ten heroes at 5 stars (every passive active): infernal-leaning allies vs a fallen team.

battles.name: five_star_kits_b
battles.about: The other five heroes at 5-6 stars (celestial faction bonus) vs a mixed team.

battles.name: manual_ultimates
battles.about: auto_ultimates off: allies cast only when requested (requests 3 ticks after a bar fills, plus some refused ones); enemy boss.

battles.name: timeout
battles.about: Two sturdy teams and max_ms 20000: the battle ends by timeout (a defeat).
